answer: Farming becomes a forge bet on surviving 58 epochs of grading, and every juniper settlement recomputes the ripple schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 58 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
